bumps.reason: Issue #2540 extends ChecksLike with check_run / workflow_runs_for_check_suite (the GET check-run + GET actions/runs?check_suite_id reads behind the run-id resolution enrichment); LocalFileGitHub is protocol-mechanically required to mirror every ChecksLike member (tests/test_local_issues.py test_local_file_github_defines_every_protocol_member), so its null-object surface grows by those two members.

Issue #3116 extends IssuesLike with create_issue / edit_issue_body (the foreman Apply step's file-issue and amend-issue requests, ADR-0010); LocalFileGitHub is protocol-mechanically required to mirror every IssuesLike member (tests/test_local_issues.py test_local_file_github_defines_every_protocol_member), so its surface grows by those two members plus the private _next_issue_number helper they share.
